🚇 One day on the London Underground — Thursday 22 October 2026.

8,783 trains across the 11 Tube lines of the world's oldest underground railway, opened in 1863. Each dot is a scheduled train following the real track, in its official line colour. Two rush hours: 471 trains on the move at 08:30 and again at 18:06.

📊 Data: DfT Bus Open Data Service GTFS (OGL) · tracks © OpenStreetMap contributors · line colours: TfL colour standard.
